# LLM / providers

One line per setting: NAME — default — meaning. Code anchors and full prose:
`docs/CONFIGURATION.md`. Index: `references/configuration.md`.

- AUTONOMOUS_CONTEXT_BUDGET_TOKENS — default: 0 (off) — a HISTORY budget for a cron/goal (autonomous) session — the compaction gauge reads `max(total/model_limit, history/budget)`, so the 85%/95% thresholds are REACHABLE on real history sizes.
- AUTONOMOUS_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS — default: 0 (off) — narrows the output ceiling on the wire for a cron/goal session only (latency is output-bound: ~60 tok/s, a 16k answer takes ~270 s).
- LLM_OUTPUT_TRUNCATION_RETRY — default: OFF (false) — on `finish_reason=length` re-run the step ONCE with a typed INTERVENTION note naming the cut and the remedy (split the write) instead of parsing a truncated answer.
- LLM_TIMEOUT_BY_OUTPUT — default: OFF (false) — per-call timeout = 90 s + expected_output_tokens/40 + 1 s per 10k UNCACHED input tokens, floor 120 s (expected output = the larger of the last two calls, capped at the session's output ceiling).
- LLM_TIMEOUT_REROUTE — default: OFF (false) — after 2 consecutive LLM timeouts in one session pin THIS session's OpenRouter provider sort to `latency`; after 3, stop retrying and end the step honestly.
- TOOL_RESULT_MAX_TOKENS — default: 6000 — cap ONE tool result's string on the wire with an honest tail `[…truncated: N of M tokens; use offset/limit to read more]`.
- LLM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS — default: 16384 — Hard cap on generated output tokens per call.
- LLM_PROMPT_CACHE / ANTHROPIC_PROMPT_CACHE — default: ON — Global prompt-caching kill-switch (either set falsey disables; default ON).
- ANTHROPIC_CACHE_TTL — default: auto — The cache window on every Anthropic `cache_control` breakpoint — `auto` | `5m` | `1h`. `auto` resolves by SESSION CLASS: **1h** for an interactive turn, **5m** for an autonomous (cron/goal/planner) run.
- GEMINI_PROMPT_CACHE — default: OFF — Opt-in Gemini explicit `cachedContents` (billed, TTL'd object).
- GEMINI_CACHE_TTL_MIN — default: 10 — TTL (minutes) for the Gemini explicit cache object.
- OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_SORT — default: unset — OpenRouter upstream ordering for the SAME model: `latency`, `throughput` or `price` (OpenRouter's default is price-first).
- OPENROUTER_REASONING_MAX_TOKENS — default: unset — bound the model's REASONING tokens on OpenRouter calls (`reasoning: {max_tokens: N}`, honoured by DeepSeek), clamped to 3/4 of the call's output cap.
- OPENROUTER_REASONING_ENABLED — default: unset — Set to `false`/`0`/`off` to send `reasoning: {enabled: false}` (thinking OFF) on OpenRouter calls; wins over `OPENROUTER_REASONING_MAX_TOKENS`.
- THINKING_CONFIG_ENABLED — default: OFF — Enables per-provider extended-thinking/reasoning-effort config (real behavior change).
- THINK_SCRUBBER_ENABLED — default: ON ("1") — Strips leaked `<think>`/`<reasoning>` blocks at the content→AIMessage seam.
- LLM_TOKEN_STREAMING — default: OFF (**ON under POLYROB_LOCAL**,) — TRUE per-token streaming.
- TASK_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS — default: unset — Caps input-token budget for the task agent (shared-client clobber guard).
- AUX_AUTO — default: OFF — Globally enable per-task aux-model auto-routing (every slot, compaction included): the provider's cheap model from `AUX_MODEL_MAP`; on `openrouter`, keyed by the MAIN model's family (`OPENROUTER_AUX_FAMILY_MAP`: `z-ai/glm-5*` → `z-ai/glm-5…
- AUX_MODEL_<SLOT> — default: unset — The per-slot primary aux model; `SLOT` is `COMPACTION`, `JUDGE` (the output-validation judge) or `REFLECTION`.
- AUX_PROVIDER_<SLOT> — default: unset — The per-slot primary provider override (`SLOT` as above).
- AUX_FALLBACK_<SLOT> — default: unset — (`SLOT` as above) comma-separated ordered fallback candidates for the slot, each `provider/model` (or a bare `model`, which auto-detects its provider). `_provision_aux_llm` walks primary→fallbacks and uses the first candidate that builds;…
- REFLECTION_LLM_ENABLED — default: **ON** — H-MEM phase consolidation via aux LLM instead of string concat.
- NATIVE_TOOLS_DEBUG — default: '' (off) — Verbose native-tool-call debug logging.
- DEFAULT_PROVIDER — default: unset — Operator-pinned default provider for new CLI/chat sessions (precedence 2 — below an explicit `-p`/API arg, above the `~/.polyrob/cli.json` stored default).
- DEFAULT_MODEL — default: unset — Operator-pinned default model, paired with `DEFAULT_PROVIDER`: every run on the pinned provider uses it — chat, cron, goals, the planner, the LLM clients and the fallback rung.
- HEAVY_MODEL — default: unset — The model for money-class work: a cron job or goal that pins no `payload.model` runs on it when it is money-class (`payload.priority=money` OR its toolset — `payload.tools`, else the rig, e.g. `rig=money_rail` — holds a money tool; `core/m…
- LLM_CUSTOM_PROVIDERS — default: unset (~/.polyrob/providers.yaml) — Path to the user-declared provider file (YAML: `providers:` map of `ProviderSpec` rows — base_url/transport/env_key/models/etc).
- LLM_AUTH_STORE_ENABLED — default: ON under POLYROB_LOCAL, else OFF — (default moved — a completed `auth add <oauth-seat>` connect was unreadable without this undocumented flag; an explicit value always wins): serve credentials from the `~/.polyrob/auth.json` store (OAuth/borrowed) in `resolve_credential`'s…
- POLYROB_AUTH_STORE — default: unset (~/.polyrob/auth.json) — Path override for the credential store (test isolation / operator relocation).
- LLM_OAUTH_ENABLED — default: OFF — permit `polyrob auth add` to run a provider's OAuth connect flow (device-code, or loopback PKCE under `POLYROB_LOCAL`). **OFF by default on every deployment INCLUDING local** — unlike the `POLYROB_LOCAL` safe group, connecting a subscripti…
- LLM_CREDENTIAL_BORROW — default: OFF — permit `resolve_credential` to serve consent-tagged borrowed credentials (imported from other CLIs' stores) from `auth.json`.
- OPENAI_API_KEY — default: unset (secret, masked) — OpenAI provider API key (also a `BotConfig` field; see the per-provider key note below).
- GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY — default: unset (secret, masked) — Google Gemini provider API key; `GOOGLE_API_KEY` is an accepted alias (checked second).
- OPENROUTER_API_KEY — default: unset (secret, masked) — OpenRouter provider API key; its presence also enables the OpenRouter remaining-balance probe in the unified ledger.
- ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — default: unset — **SECRET, masked** — Anthropic provider API key.
- DEEPSEEK_API_KEY — default: unset — **SECRET, masked** — DeepSeek provider API key.
- DEEPSEEK_API_URL — default: https://api.deepseek.com/v1 — DeepSeek endpoint.
- NVIDIA_API_KEY — default: unset — **SECRET, masked** — NVIDIA NIM provider API key.
- NVIDIA_API_URL — default: https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1 — NVIDIA NIM endpoint.
- OPENROUTER_SITE_URL — default: '' — The `HTTP-Referer` URL sent to OpenRouter (its app attribution).
- OPENROUTER_SITE_NAME — default: POLYROB AI Agent — The `X-Title` app name sent to OpenRouter.
- PERPLEXITY_API_KEY — default: unset — **SECRET, masked** — Perplexity API key; the discovery pack's search actions are off without it.
- AUTOV2_LLM_TIMEOUT_OVERRIDE — default: unset — Debug override (seconds) that replaces the computed adaptive per-call LLM timeout (token/tool/vision-scaled, min 120s) with a fixed value.
